en: The postcard shows a sepia-toned photograph of an industrial construction site labeled 'Wivstavarvs Sulfitfabrik, Fagervik, under byggnation.' The image depicts a partially constructed factory building with scaffolding, numerous workers, and equipment scattered on rocky ground. The reverse side contains Swedish text regarding postage rates and lines for address writing. The publisher's note at the bottom states 'M. Sellman, Vivsta.'
